title: I can’t stop thinking about the @Wicked Movie. happy release day!!!! ...
transcript: It really was no miracle. What happened was just this. The wind began to switch the house to pitch. And suddenly the hinges started to unhitch. Just then, the witch, to satisfy an itch, went flying on her broomstick, thumbing for a hitch.
classificationReason: Explicitly references the Wicked film ('Wicked Movie', 'happy release day'). Per rules, film/movie reviews are classified as 'other' with null showId, even when the stage version is on the list.
